public.task: Complete a support compensation action once; avoid duplicate customer effects.

operations.description: Creates a case keyed to the incoming ticket's stable source_event_id. Replaying the same event returns the same case without creating another case.
Adds a 25-dollar goodwill credit to a customer ledger. Every accepted invocation posts a new credit; there is no request token or replay deduplication feature. Replies can be lost.
Queues a notification of the credit; the provider can deduplicate deliveries by a message reference when supplied.
